question: Which exact-target functions implement opendir/readdir/closedir?
prototype_hypothesis: opendir(path)->DIR*|NULL, readdir(DIR*)->dirent*|NULL, closedir(DIR*)->int, NuttX libc semantics
callsite_evidence: NSH nsh_foreach_direntry (sub_C23E1A8) calls sub_C1E4528(path); loops sub_C1E4590(dir) until NULL passing each entry to a callback; then sub_C1E4564(dir); on NULL open it prints 'Could not open %s (is procfs mounted?)'
control_flow_evidence: same helper walks /proc for `top`, so the three calls are the libc directory API
ownership_analysis: DIR handle is owned by the caller between opendir and closedir; the dirent returned by readdir is valid until the next readdir/closedir.
unsafe_assumptions: STATIC_RECOVERED; d_name offset (+1) is verified only in the emulator
recommended_probe: List /data/app from the Supervisor on Mirage 043 and compare with NSH ls.
